title: Duel Decks: Sorin vs. Tibalt: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: He vowed he would never rest until he reached his destination. He doesn't know how right he was.
The lacerators cut themselves before each hunt. They must feed before the sun rises or bleed to death.
"I search for a vision of Zendikar that does not include the Eldrazi." —Expedition journal entry
Sins that would be too gruesome in the light of day are made more pleasing in the dark of night.
The swamps go silent at its approach, but it still hears the heartbeat of the prey within.
"You may enter the city—once the toll is paid."
The most genteel facades hide the most abominable desires.
"Ghoulcallers trying to get in, geists trying to get out . . . . This duty is never dull."
After his death, the general was reunited with fallen soldiers from over thirty of his campaigns.
Empires rise and fall, but evil is eternal.
His verdict is always guilty. His sentence is always death.
"Sheesh! How am I supposed to make a decent living around here?" —Cabal grave robber
"All your steel won't protect you if your will is weak."
"Jharic returned from Grixis changed, a haunted look in her eyes. She destroyed them with an unholy glee that made me shudder." —Knight-Captain Wyhorn
The murdered inhabitants of Hollowhenge impart to the living the terror they felt in death.
Many who cross Sorin's path come down with a sudden and fatal case of being-in-the-way-of-a-millennia-old-vampire.
"I need never remember my past associates, my victims, my mistakes. Innistrad preserves them all for me." —Sorin Markov
A gwyllion's favorite trap is the vanity mirror. A bewitched piece of glass traps the looker's soul and does away with the body.
Knowledge demands sacrifice.
"My 'condition' is a trial. The weak are consumed by it. The strong transcend it." —Sorin Markov
Plate mail, the skin of the chest, the rib cage, the heart—all useless against the mage who can reach directly for the soul.
Without the interfering hands of civilization, nature will always shape itself to its own needs.
With great power comes great risk of getting yourself killed.
Each small blaze she sets jogs her memory, letting her piece together the mystery of her own fiery end.
"They may show up with the wrong thigh bone or mandible, but they always show up." —Zul Ashur, lich lord
Its fiery paws make it easy to track, which is very useful when you want to go in exactly the opposite direction.
"The day is mine! I sent three such creatures against my foe, then watched as my magefire popped her soldiers like overripe spleenfruits." —Dobruk the Unstable, pyromancer
"Her voice is disaster, painful and final." —Matoc, lavamancer
"There's no heron in the moon! It's a shrew, a five-legged shrew, with a voice like whispering thunder!"
"Behind every devil's mayhem lurks a demon's scheme." —Rem Karolus, Blade of the Inquisitors
"Within blood is life. Within life is fire. Within fire is the path to our masters' glory!"
"Well, how could I know they'd explode?" —Gregel, township militia
It's not just the wind. It's not all in your head. And it's *definitely* something to worry about.
Barbarians equate courage with the ability to endure pain.
"Avacyn has abandoned us! We have nothing left except what we can take!"
After millennia asleep, the Eldrazi had forgotten about Zendikar's fiery temper and dislike of strangers.
Innistrad pyromancers find their best raw materials in the fury of the dead.
Chaos does not choose its enemies.
"I've seen death before. My mother succumbing to illness, my comrades bleeding on the battlefield . . . But I'd never seen anything as dreadful as that." —Taani, berserker of Etlan
"What good is your blade without your breath?" —Greht, Gathan warlord
"Pained defiance or shameful surrender—every reaction is a pleasant surprise." —Tibalt
"Enough!"
In the spirit of inquiry, Tibalt applied a battery of agony spells. They yielded nothing on the vampire's whereabouts, but the screams were reward enough.
Gyara Spearhurler would have been renowned for her deadly accuracy, if it weren't for her deadly accuracy.
A devil's hands are never idle.
